home.title: Saloum Évasion — immersive stays in Sine-Saloum
home.description: All-inclusive stays in Ndangane and the Sine-Saloum islands: lodging, experiences, local food and transfer in a single request.
home.heading: The Saloum, lived from within
home.lead: Turnkey stays designed by people from here. Villa or lodge, pirogue trips through the bolongs, Serer villages and local food, all in a single booking.
home.universes: Four ways to taste the delta
home.step1: Pick a signature stay or build your own: lodging, outings, meals and transfer.
home.step2: Wave, Orange Money or bank card. Availability confirmed with each partner.
home.step3: Your driver is waiting, your host welcomes you. The programme adapts on the spot, on WhatsApp.
home.commitment: Tourism that keeps the delta alive
home.commitmentText: Our stays are designed with Saloum families, guides and boatmen: what you spend stays here.
home.contact: A question? A host will answer.
home.trustTransfer: Private transfer from AIBD or Dakar
home.trustHost: Your host on WhatsApp, 7 days a week
home.filmLead: One morning, one tide, one pirogue. A few moments to feel the Saloum before you set foot there.
home.filmPlace: Filmed in Ndangane, Mar Lodj and on Bird Island
home.manifestoText: Big platforms sell a bed, resorts sell an enclosure. We open the delta to you the way those born here live it: its tides, its villages, its flavours.
home.why1Title: A host, not a call centre
home.why1Text: Someone from Ndangane welcomes you, knows every boatman and adjusts the programme to the tide and the weather.
home.why2Text: Lodging, outings, meals and transfer in one cart, one payment, one contact person.
home.why3Text: Mangrove oysters fresh from the water, tea with a local family, village wrestling: the real life of the Sine-Saloum.
home.why4Title: Tourism that stays in the village
home.why4Text: Guides, boatmen and cooks are paid directly and fairly. Small groups, no tourist factory.
home.featuredAccent: we take care of the rest.
home.destinationsText: About three hours’ drive from Dakar, Ndangane faces the islands of the delta. It is our base camp: every outing leaves from here by pirogue with the same crew, who know the tides by heart.
home.mapTitle: Stylised map of the Saloum delta
home.mapDescription: Where the destinations lie around Ndangane, our base camp.
home.commitmentQuote: “The traveller leaves with memories, the village keeps a living. That is what Teranga means.”
home.commitment1: Guides, boatmen and cooks hired in Ndangane and paid a fair price.
home.commitment2: A share of every stay goes to a village project (amount to be confirmed).
home.commitment3: Small groups and respect for the mangrove nesting areas.
home.commitment4: Verified reviews: only travellers who stayed can leave a rating.
home.ctaTitle: Something specific in mind? Talk to your host.
home.ctaText: Birthday, team retreat, honeymoon, family with children: we build the stay with you, in French, English or Wolof.
